## `GET /api/v1/access/export`

Write the live access of some scopes as an access file

Needs the ADMIN role on the instance. Planning the text unedited plans nothing.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | query | no | list of text | ``instance`` (the default) alone, or one or more environment names; repeat the parameter. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `AccessExportOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `AccessExportOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/access/plan`

Say what applying an access file would change, and every problem that stops it

Needs the ADMIN role on the instance. A file with problems is a plan with problems, not an error: the answer is 200 and lists all of them. Nothing is changed.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `AccessFileIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_name` | text | no |  |
| `text` | text | yes |  |
| `allow_lockout` | true or false | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `AccessPlanOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `413` | The request body is larger than the server accepts. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `AccessPlanOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_name` | text | yes |  |
| `file_sha256` | text | yes |  |
| `manages` | list of text | yes |  |
| `creates` | list of `AccessChangeOut` | yes |  |
| `changed` | list of `AccessChangeOut` | yes |  |
| `removals` | list of `AccessChangeOut` | yes |  |
| `releases` | list of text | yes |  |
| `starts` | list of text | yes |  |

| `fingerprint` | text | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/access/apply`

Make an access file's changes in one audited transaction, or none of them

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Needs the ADMIN role on the instance. The plan is made again under a lock: 409 when the file or access changed since the plan with `plan_fingerprint` (plan again), and 409 when the changes would end the caller's last way to administer (apply in two steps). 422 lists every problem of the file (at most 50).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `AccessApplyIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_name` | text | no |  |
| `text` | text | yes |  |
| `plan_fingerprint` | text | yes |  |
| `source_commit` | text or null | no |  |
| `allow_lockout` | true or false | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `AccessApplyOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `413` | The request body is larger than the server accepts. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `AccessApplyOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apply_id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `file_sha256` | text | yes |  |
| `source_commit` | text or null | yes |  |
| `created` | whole number | yes |  |
| `changed` | whole number | yes |  |
| `removed` | whole number | yes |  |
| `released` | list of text | yes |  |
| `applied_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/access/managed-scopes`

List the scopes access files manage, for whoever manages row filters and masks

Each scope with the name of the file that manages it and when that file was applied, sorted by scope. A write of a row filter or column mask in a managed scope answers 409; this tells a policy manager so before the write. Needs `MANAGE_POLICY` on the instance (which the `ADMIN` role holds); `GET /api/v1/access/status` tells an administrator more.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `ManagedScopeBriefOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |
